entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-15
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • productVersion.txt is non-shipping in 8.0 aspnetcore #64066
  • Non-framework JavaScript files fail to load due to unintended fingerprint markers #64060
  • The browser is stuck and no response after dotnet watch for web app when `Ctrl + S` in cshtml/razor.css/razor file. #64051
  • [WebToolsE2E] After creating a Blazor Web App project with the ".dev.localhost TLD" selected, I added some code and ran it, but an exception occurred: System.Net.Http.HttpRequestException: 'No such host is known.' #64050
  • After installing 10.0 RTM, publish 9.0 Blazor WebAssembly app, some errors "MONO_WASM: mono_wasm_load_runtime () failed" appears when go to the Counter page #64049
  • OpenApi components schema $ref may not correct #64048
  • Benchmark stopped running: QueryCompilation #64046

Closed

  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `aspnetcore/release/9.0` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #64062
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `aspnetcore/release/8.0` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #64061
  • .NET 10 rc2 Blazor WebAssembly app does not work on Azure App Services #64041
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `aspnetcore/release/8.0` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #64042
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `aspnetcore/release/9.0` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #64040
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `aspnetcore/release/9.0` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #64052
  • When logging into Blazor web Inauth project using invalid characters, the "Error: Invalid login attempt" error message appears in an incorrect location and format #64002
  • Quarantine failing Passkey tests in `UserStoreTest` #64055
  • New item on 2025 #64044

PullRequests

Created

  • Add comprehensive ObsoletionReport.md tracking all obsolete APIs across the codebase #64059
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
  • Enhanced navigation should not scroll before content renders #64054
    area-blazor, 10.0.x

Merged

  • Mark productVersion.txt as shipping artifact in 8.0 #64067
    Attention: Shared Code Modified, 8.0.22
  • Fix chunked request parsing #64037
    area-networking, 11.0-preview1
  • [release/10.0] Allow `UserStore` to update passkey name #64014
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.0
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #64043
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, 10.0.0
  • Fix `UserStoreTest` #64019
    area-identity, 11.0-preview1
  • Merging internal commits for release/8.0 #64035
    8.0.22

Updated

  • Add AllowedUsernameCharacters to InvalidUserName error #62111
    area-identity, community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun
  • [SignalR] Add parameter index to invocation binding exception message #64016
    area-signalr
  • Blazor 404 code re-execution is compatible with `OnNavigateAsync` #64034
    area-blazor, 10.0.x
  • Ignore "From" when serializing a JsonPatchDocument for "add", "remove", "replace" and "test" operations #64031
    feature-json-patch, community-contribution, area-minimal
  • Improve stack trace consistency for generic types across runtimes #63945
    area-infrastructure, community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #64021
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, build-ops
